correctness.rationale: Every Rademacher column has exactly one of the orthogonal projective lines s_+=(1,1)/sqrt(2), s_-=(1,-1)/sqrt(2); both observed => Y rank two and post-truncation optimal error b². All columns of one line, each event probability 2^-l, give rank-one errors b²+(a²-b²)rho(1-c)/(c+rho(1-c)) or the swapped expression. With rho=(b/a)^(4q+2), summation proves the exact all-q,all-l law. Strict concavity of g(t)=t/(rho+(1-rho)t) proves extrema. At c=0/1 a sign line is exactly trailing right singular, so even q->infinity leaves excess (a²-b²)/2^l. Independently enumerated sign-line scenarios and extremal rational matrices; verified sample A=[[2,1],[1,2]], l=2 has mean squared error 3. Distinct singular values and exact range-revealing convention are essential.
